dataset_scope: CIFAR-100 train split scalar audit arrays
release_policy: Derived scalar arrays only; no images, file paths, upstream datasets, weights, checkpoints, or retraining logs.

split_ids.purpose: Deterministic 80/20 split for zero-GPU tabular gate-script checks on released arrays; cached manuscript summaries remain the source for reported multi-split results.
split_ids.generator: NumPy default_rng seed 0 over anonymous sample_id values

missing_or_excluded_columns.reason: No verified anonymized CIFAR-100 train-label array was located in the release workspace.
No verified per-sample DDPM score-norm array was located in the release workspace.
Semantic CLIP-space variants require re-scoring under the relevant model/license terms and are not redistributed as independent scalar arrays in this release.
ResNet-50 second-learner transfer is provided through cached aggregate summaries rather than per-sample CE arrays, because a verified per-sample ResNet-50 CE file was not available for this release.

full_regeneration_note: Full regeneration of proxy scores or retraining-based Gate 3 transfer results requires upstream datasets/models and GPU scoring or retraining outside this lightweight artifact.
